shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,240p' AGENTS.md; sed -n '1,240p' package.json; sed -n '1,260p' app/layout.tsx; sed -n '1,260p' app/page.tsx; sed -n '1,320p' app/ProductGrid.tsx; sed -n '1,260p' app/ProductSkeleton.tsx; sed -n '1,320p' 'app/product/[slug]/page.tsx'; sed -n '1,400p' app/globals.css; sed -n '1,200p' next.config.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,470p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/view-transitions.md; rg -n \"transitionTypes\" node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/02-components/link.mdx node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/02-components/link.md node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference -g 'link*' 2>/dev/null | sed -n '1,160p'; rg --files lib test tests __tests__ 2>/dev/null | sed -n '1,200p'; sed -n '1,220p' lib/products.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '490,545p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/02-components/link.md; rg -n \"export.*ViewTransition|ViewTransition\" node_modules/@types/react/index.d.ts node_modules/react/index.js package-lock.json pnpm-lock.yaml yarn.lock 2>/dev/null | sed -n '1,200p'; git status --short; rg -n 'next/link|product-card|product-hero|Suspense' app -g '*.tsx' -g '*.css'"

/bin/bash -lc "ls -la node_modules/react; sed -n '1,180p' node_modules/react/index.js; rg -n \"ViewTransition\" node_modules/next/dist/compiled/react*/**/*.d.ts node_modules/@types/react -g '*.d.ts' 2>/dev/null | sed -n '1,200p'; npm ls react next --depth=0"

/bin/bash -lc "git diff -- app/PageTransition.tsx app/ProductGrid.tsx app/page.tsx 'app/product/[slug]/page.tsx' app/globals.css; sed -n '1,140p' app/page.tsx; sed -n '1,160p' 'app/product/[slug]/page.tsx'; sed -n '1,120p' app/PageTransition.tsx"
/bin/bash -lc "git status --short; git diff -- tsconfig.json package.json package-lock.json; git diff --check; sed -n '1,240p' tsconfig.json; sed -n '130,240p' node_modules/@types/react/canary.d.ts"
/bin/bash -lc "git diff --check; git diff --stat; git diff -- app/PageTransition.tsx app/ProductGrid.tsx app/page.tsx 'app/product/[slug]/page.tsx' app/globals.css; git status --short"

/bin/bash -lc "nl -ba app/PageTransition.tsx | sed -n '1,120p'; nl -ba app/ProductGrid.tsx | sed -n '1,120p'; nl -ba app/page.tsx | sed -n '1,120p'; nl -ba 'app/product/[slug]/page.tsx' | sed -n '1,140p'; nl -ba app/globals.css | sed -n '120,245p'"
